title: Tanks
og_description: Download this package (80 assets) for free, CC0 licensed!
visual_summary: A 2D tank-battle sprite pack in Kenney's signature flat-vector style. Multiple tank hulls in green, tan/sand, and gray, each swappable with several turret/cannon variants plus muzzle flashes. Includes rolling treads animation frames, six bullet/missile projectiles with matching in-flight sprites, 12-frame explosion sequence, a wooden crate prop, arrow UI indicators, and a flying airstrike missile. Clean rounded shapes, no black outlines, bright saturated palette of grass green, sky blue, sandy beige, steel gray, and warm red/orange explosion pops. Side-view, slight 3/4 read on turrets, designed for both side-scroller and top-down use.

zip_inventory.format_notes: All PNGs RGBA. Spritesheets use paletted PNG mode (P) — decode via PIL or convert in engine.
